reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000390 (the melody read from 000390a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Neil Dougall has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1831, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Tenor-lead arr., Purcell James Mansfield has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; the tune was in print by 1831, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000390a.nwc).
